neutral.EN: I'll keep that intelligence in mind.
Good to have fresh news from the area.
neutral.TL: Mabuting makatanggap ng bagong balita mula sa lugar.

neutral.EN: Understood. That changes how we look at the sector.
neutral.TL: Naintindihan. Binabago niyan ang pananaw natin sa lugar.

neutral.EN: Good information. We'll plan around it.
neutral.TL: Magandang impormasyon. Magpaplano tayo batay diyan.

neutral.EN: Noted. Reliable news is hard to come by.
neutral.TL: Tala ko na. Mahirap makahanap ng maaasahang balita.
Salamat sa pagpapanatili sa aking may alam.

neutral.EN: That helps clear up a few rumors. Thanks.
neutral.TL: Nakatulong 'yan para maalis ang ilang sabi-sabi. Salamat.

warm.EN: Thanks for telling me. I'll keep that in mind.
warm.TL: Salamat sa pagsabi. Tatandaan ko iyan.

warm.EN: That's huge news, friend! Thank you for sharing.
warm.TL: Napakalaking balita niyan, kaibigan! Salamat sa pagbabahagi.

warm.EN: Always glad to know you're looking out for me with news like this.
warm.TL: Lagi akong masaya na binabantayan mo ako sa mga ganitong balita.

warm.EN: You have great sources! Thanks a ton.
warm.TL: Napakagaling ng mga pinagkukunan mo! Maraming salamat.

warm.EN: I really appreciate you giving me the heads up first.
warm.TL: Talagang pinahahalagahan ko na ako ang unang pinaalalahanan mo.

warm.EN: Good news is worth its weight in gold out here. Thanks!
warm.TL: Ang magandang balita ay ginto ang halaga rito. Salamat!

warm.EN: Thanks for sharing that with me. It gives me hope.
warm.TL: Salamat sa pagbabahagi niyan sa akin. Nagbibigay ito ng pag-asa.

warm.EN: I'm relieved to hear that. Thank you so much, partner.
warm.TL: Nakahinga ako nang maluwag nang marinig 'yan. Salamat nang marami, kasama.

warm.EN: That's fantastic information. Appreciate you keeping us safe.
warm.TL: Napakagandang impormasyon. Salamat sa pag-iingat sa atin.

warm.EN: Thanks! Let's make sure the others hear this too.
warm.TL: Salamat! Tiyakin nating marinig din ito ng iba.

guarded.EN: Where did you hear that from?
I'll believe it when I see it with my own eyes.
guarded.TL: Maniwala lang ako kapag nakita ko na ng sarili kong mata.

guarded.EN: Rumors can get people killed out here. Be sure of your facts.
guarded.TL: Ang tsismis ay nakamamatay dito. Tiyakin mo ang katotohanan.

guarded.EN: Noted, but I'll verify that myself.
guarded.TL: Tala ko na, pero kumpirmahin ko muna sa sarili ko.

guarded.EN: Could be a setup. Don't act on rumors too quickly.
guarded.TL: Baka bitag 'yan. Huwag kumilos sa sabi-sabi nang padalos-dalos.

guarded.EN: I'll take it under advisement, but keep my distance.
guarded.TL: Isasaalang-alang ko, pero magmamasid pa rin ako mula sa malayo.

guarded.EN: Don't spread that around until we know it's solid.
guarded.TL: Huwag mong ikalat 'yan hangga't di tiyak na totoo.

guarded.EN: Heard. I'll watch for confirming signs.
guarded.TL: Narinig ko. Magmamasid ako ng mga patunay.
